name: OpenCode Go
notes: Subscription with no per-token prices; each model carries the pay-as-you-go list price of the same model, so Cost is what a request would cost there. Go is designed for OpenCode and other coding agents: use it only with coding agents, as traffic is monitored for abuse. Clients should send their own user agent and a stable x-opencode-session; the gateway forwards both when the client sends them (the forwardedClientHeaders quirk) and sends nothing for one the client left out. Free models are served only to OpenCode itself (403 for other clients), so none are shipped. The Muse Spark Contributor models train on prompts, which conflicts with ADR 0004, so they are not shipped either. Limits are 20% of a monthly allowance per 5 hours and 50% per week (the week resets Monday 00:00 UTC); no quota endpoint is documented, so there is no quota reader. No exhaustedErrorCodes: the Provider doesn't document the status or code it answers with once a limit is reached; add the quirk once a real Error Capture shows it. Every text model is reachable through chat completions because OpenCode translates the other wire formats. The OpenCode terms page returned 404 when checked.

upstreamModels.notes: Context size, max output, vision and release date are what the live /models JSON reports; prices are the pay-as-you-go table on opencode.ai/docs/console/models, the equivalent Cost of a request. The price is the peak price (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday), double the off-peak price in the live JSON (0.15/0.60/0.003), so Cost is never understated.
